title: FBI briefing to Congress and ongoing FBI investigation of legacy program

tellings.quote: Cuz I'm told that the briefing that the FBI gave in Congress really blew people away. And watch that FBI ongoing investigation. I've dealt with some of the people on the investigation team.

plain: A briefing that the FBI, the US federal police, gave to members of Congress in 2025 is said to have stunned the people who heard it. The FBI is also said to be running an ongoing investigation tied to a hidden government programme believed to hold UFO material. The Australian investigative journalist Ross Coulthart passes this on as something he was told. He urges people to keep an eye on the investigation and says he has dealt with some of the people on its team, which would mean federal police are now looking into the matter themselves.
